name: archlang
description: ArchLang: write floor plans as code, compiled and checked by a deterministic compiler. Skills to author, edit, review and export .arch plans through the archlang CLI, and the ArchLang MCP server.

interface.longDescription: ArchLang: write floor plans as code, compiled and checked by a deterministic compiler. Skills to author, edit, review and export .arch plans through the archlang CLI, and the ArchLang MCP server. The MCP server is hosted at https://mcp.archlang.uk/mcp with no sign-in: it compiles a plan to an SVG drawing and returns the plan's measured facts and lint findings.
defaultPrompt: Design a two-bedroom flat of about 75 m² as an ArchLang plan and check it against the brief.
Make the bedroom in plan.arch 1 m wider and show me what changed.
Put plan.arch on an A3 sheet and give me a link to download it as a PDF.
